_doc: Thread mining (assistant/scripts/tracking/mining.py, ruling 3 of TRACKING_DESIGN.md) and the personal-text exception (scripts/text_gate.py, ruling 13). Every word list the code matches on lives here so another organization edits a file, not code. Regexes are Python, case-insensitive. mail_arm.py's bill / renewal / shipment patterns are NOT repeated here: mining imports them and only adds what is listed under money.extra.

people._doc: A date beside one of these words, said by a couple / planner / vendor / family / friend / owner, is a commitment worth a calendar hold. The word may sit in the same sentence or the one before it. A lead's wedding date is never a hold (an inquiry is not a booking): lead_wedding_day sentences from a lead are skipped unless they also name a lead_meeting word, and inquiry_new tickets are not mined at all. A hold is only for the owners' own plans (2026-10-28): a message matching third_party_message (a prayer request) is about someone else and gets no hold; a sentence matching third_party (a surgery, a hospital stay) is skipped and never lends its commitment word to the next line; a sentence with no date of its own borrows the one before only when it names a time itself.
people.commitment: \b(meet(?:ing)?|call|coming|come (?:over|by|to|at)|arriv\w*|drop(?:ping)? (?:off|by)|pick(?:ing)? up|pickup|send(?:ing)?|deliver\w*|due|see you|dinner|lunch|brunch|breakfast|coffee|party|birthday|appointment|appt|leave|leaving|leaves|flight|boat|train|show|game|church|rsvp|deadline|book(?:ed|ing)?|reserv\w*|walk.?through|rehearsal|ceremony|reception|shoot|session|tour|visit\w*|trip|camp\w*|hike|be there|be at|starts?|start at|ends?|open(?:s|ing)?|close(?:s|d)?|at \d|from \d|until|by (?:noon|then|\d)|plan(?:s|ning)?|hang|join|over at|head(?:ing)? (?:out|over|up|down)|we'?re (?:doing|going)|i'?m (?:doing|going)|let'?s|works? for (?:me|us)|confirm\w*|scheduled|set for|moved to|pushed to|rescheduled)\b

money._doc: Senders whose dates are duties: due / renewal / action-required. mail_arm.py already arms bill-due, renewal and delivery reminders silently from mail; mining adds the shapes below from the SAME senders and proposes them on a card.
money.subject: \b(statement|invoice|payment|bill|autopay|renew\w*|policy|premium|subscription|membership|tax|1099|w-?2|refund|balance|past due|overdue|declined|failed|action required|verify|expir\w*|final notice|suspend\w*|cancel\w*)\b
money.extra: \b(action (?:required|needed)|respond by|reply by|verify (?:by|before)|confirm (?:by|before)|complete (?:by|before)|last day|final notice|final reminder|deadline|expires? (?:on|in|at)|expiring|payment (?:failed|declined|returned|unsuccessful)|card (?:was )?declined|update your (?:card|payment)|past due|overdue|will be (?:suspended|cancell?ed|disconnected|charged)|auto-?renews?|free trial ends|trial (?:ends|expires)|price (?:increase|change)|goes up on)\b

dates._doc: Relative day words resolved from the day the message was sent (the shape of the property OS's vendor_threads._when). Absolute dates come from mail_arm.find_dates.

skip.noise: \b(verification code|your code is|one-time|otp|unsubscribe|reply stop|flash sale|% off|promo code|liked|loved|laughed at|emphasized|questioned|disliked)\b|^\d{4,8}$|wm\.attn\.tv|^example-SEND
skip.chat_handled_by_agent: \b(remind me|put (?:it|that|this|the \w+) on (?:my|the|our) calendar|add (?:it|that|this|the \w+) to (?:my|the|our) calendar|schedule (?:a|the|an)|set up a call)\b

classes._doc: Who the sender is -> which lane the proposal lands in and who gets the card. Owners' own words (chat) go to their own lane.

personal_text_exception._doc: Ruling 13 (2026-10-15): a personal text may get a draft card ONLY when it is time-related (a date or time AND a plan word) or money-tied (an amount, or pay / owe / venmo words). The switch is config.json -> phone.personal_exceptions; the vocabulary is here.
